title.zh: 受保护场所第 2 号命令 2023

source.name: Attorney General's Chambers, Brunei Darussalam (AGC) — LAWS OF BRUNEI / Government Gazette

completenessNote: 来源为 AGC 官方 PDF《S-13-2023-PROTECTED-PLACES-NO.-2-ORDER-2023.pdf》（3 页），本次切分 3 条。该 PDF 为扫描件 + OCR 文本层，正文按版式位置重建：已剔除页眉页脚与边栏条标题、回接折行；未改写措辞、未增删内容。OCR 层面可能存在个别粘连或形近字，逐字引用请以原始 PDF 为准。

text.en: This Order may be cited as the Protected Places Order, 2023 and shall commence on the date it is made.

The places specified in the first column of the Schedule, which are more particularly described in the plans specified in the second column thereof deposited in the office of the Surveyor-General, are hereby declared to be protected places for the purposes of the Act. Authorities

The authorities specified in the third column of the Schedule are from whom permission to enter the protected places are to be received.

SCHEDULE (paragraphs 2 and 3) Place Plan Number Authority Building and area GT150002BM General Manager Print Plus Sendirian Berhad Print Plus Mukim Berakas A Sendirian Berhad Brunei and Muara District Building and area GT210001TU Director of Prisons. Maraburong Prison Phase III Simpang 1111 Jalan Tutong Kampung Maraburong Mukim Keriam Tutong District Made this 18th. day of Syawal, 1444 Hijriah corresponding to the 9th. day of May, 2023.

DATO SERI SETIA A WANG HAJI AHMADDIN BIN HAJI ABDUL RAHMAN Minister of Home Affairs.
